coordinates.height_datum: radial elevation above reference sphere, not sea level

globe.handedness: right-handed Cartesian cross product: X cross Y = Z
globe.poles: unit positions are exact [0, +/-1, 0]; tangent orientation retains anchor longitude

city.height: absolute radial elevation; schematic viewer draws this vertically
city.rotation: degrees; positive width rotation runs from east toward north

patch.mesh: Cartesian surface displacement projected onto the anchor east/up/north frame
patch.rows: south to north; columns west to east

tile.rows: north to south; columns west to east
tile.samples: inclusive boundary indices; tile requests themselves cannot cross a seam or pole

unreal_boundary.axis_mapping: Unreal X is source east, Y is source north, Z is source radial up; left-handed Z-up, so copied triangle winding reverses. Implemented by the native core and the FantasyWorldGenerator plugin, not by this producer.
unreal_boundary.origin: caller-chosen tangent anchor (latitude, longitude, origin height); lengths scale by 100 once at that boundary

kernel.storage: host-owned atomic commit; pending snapshots are checkpoints
